text:
claire: Heads up  were lining up the release post + benchmark webinar for next Tue. Need eng to confirm changelog PR and docs anchors for our CTA buttons. Also want a short canary to validate perf numbers. Can we get PRs merged in ~36h?
ajay: Share the PR link and the exact anchor slugs you want. Ill try to block a 1hr canary.
claire: Draft changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5007 changelog at docs/changes/2026-07-22.md. Marketing wants anchors for 'benchmarks' and 'dedicated-trial' + a sample JSON for the inbound form. Proposed canary: Tue 07:30-08:30 PT.
monica: I can add anchors and the JSON snippet. Which anchor text should marketing link to exactly?
claire: Use "Benchmarks & latency" (#benchmarks) and "Start Dedicated trial" (#dedicated-trial). Keep anchor titles verbatim so CTAs line up.
ajay: We'll mention fallback to a smaller quantized model variant under load; include that as a one-liner in changelog. Infra: @infra-bot can you reserve the canary slot and create an rc tag?
infra-bot: Canary slot reserved: 2026-07-22T07:30:00-07:00 to 2026-07-22T08:30:00-07:00. Tag created: rc/2026-07-22-bench. :white_check_mark:
henry: Growth needs the final docs URL so nurture flows can use the anchors and tag leads. Also want a sample webhook payload to test lead routing.
monica: I'll add /docs/benchmarks#benchmarks and /docs/dedicated#dedicated-trial and include this sample webhook in the patch: 
```n{
  \"event\": \"signup\",
  \"source\": \"marketing-web\",
  \"interest\": \"dedicated-trial\"
}
```
ajay: Good. I'll run a quick integration test after docs merge; if anchors resolve we'll merge changelog. If perf spikes during canary we revert and post a reduced announcement (webinar only + signup link).
claire: Timeline proposal: docs + changelog merged by Mon 20:00 UTC, canary Tue 07:30-08:30 PT, public post Tue 09:30 PT, webinar Wed 16:00 UTC. Bench numbers will be included in the blog and the webinar demo. Everyone ok?
ajay: Eng good. Ill aim to land changelog earlier this afternoon. If something blocks we delay public post by 2h.
monica: Docs PR coming in ~2h. Will include anchors, CTA snippet, and the sample webhook. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1134
henry: Growth will run a dry lead test after docs merge and tag leads with "bench-interested". Will post results here.
claire: Thanks all Ill lock calendar and draft partner pre-announce for 30m before public post. Quick merge steps for eng: 
```n# land changelog commit
git fetch origin
git checkout main
git cherry-pick c7d1e9a
git push origin main
```
ajay: Copy. Will monitor canary and merge if green.
claire: Awesome closing the loop: docs PR + changelog must be merged by Mon 20:00 UTC. Ping here for any timing shifts. :rocket:
